spanish: Y degolló, y tomó Moisés la sangre, y dio sobre cuernos del altar alrededor en su dedo, y pecó el altar, y la sangre derramó a base del altar, y lo santificó para expiar sobre él.

findings.issue: Piel of H2398 is a transitive purge/cleanse with the altar as object; pecó keeps the qal sense “sinned” and drops that stem force.
בְּ is marked only as a preposition, so in/on/with stay open; en selects the locative.

notes: Other clauses keep person, number, order, and the named actor Moisés.
